rationale: Adapted from accepted RFC 45 and its maintainer's URL replacement tool: quoted strings avoid a redundant literal syntax and semicolon-selection ambiguity.
Adapted deprecation example. Warn only: replacing toPath is not universally equivalent because it returns a normalized string, not a path; Nix issue 12407 documents remaining use cases.
negatives: let toPath = x: x; in toPath "/path"

rationale: Adapted solved forum bug: a recursive assignment captures itself rather than the outer variable. Existing manual_inherit offers the reported correction.
before: let enableWayland = true; in (rec { enableWayland = enableWayland; }).enableWayland
after: let enableWayland = true; in rec { inherit enableWayland; }.enableWayland

rationale: Adapted merged makeBinPath fix: optional with a list produces a nested list. Correction changes shape intentionally; only a known flat-list consumer justifies it.
before: { lib, enableMail, gnused, inetutils, mailutils }: lib.makeBinPath ([ gnused ] ++ lib.optional enableMail [ inetutils mailutils ])
after: { lib, enableMail, gnused, inetutils, mailutils }: lib.makeBinPath ([ gnused ] ++ lib.optionals enableMail [ inetutils mailutils ])
negatives: { lib, enabled, item }: lib.optional enabled item

rationale: Adapted review and merged correction in PR 488516: optionals returns [] when false, incompatible with this string concatenation.
before: { lib, needsPatch }: "echo start\n" + lib.optionals needsPatch ''echo patch''
after: { lib, needsPatch }: "echo start\n" + lib.optionalString needsPatch ''echo patch''
negatives: { lib, enabled, items }: lib.optionals enabled items

rationale: Adapted completed canonical-lib migration. This pair already has a lib argument: no caller/header migration is needed.
Adapted merged removal of broad meta with-lib scopes; narrower maintainer lists remain allowed. Advisory only without lexical resolution.
before: { lib }: { meta = with lib; { license = licenses.mit; }; }
negatives: { lib }: { maintainers = with lib.maintainers; [ alice bob ]; }

rationale: Adapted merged hash modernization, with the hash already represented as SRI to isolate a key-only rename. Not evidence that every sha256 field is deprecated.
before: { fetchFromGitHub }: fetchFromGitHub { owner = "reyammer"; repo = "shellnoob"; rev = "72cf49804d8ea3de1faa7fae5794449301987bff"; sha256 = "sha256-xF9OTFFe8godW4+z9MFaFEkjE9FB42bKWwdl9xRcmEo="; }
after: { fetchFromGitHub }: fetchFromGitHub { owner = "reyammer"; repo = "shellnoob"; rev = "72cf49804d8ea3de1faa7fae5794449301987bff"; hash = "sha256-xF9OTFFe8godW4+z9MFaFEkjE9FB42bKWwdl9xRcmEo="; }

rationale: Adapted scanner/hook placement correction. The cited review also rejects name-only movement when libgirepository is linked; advisory, not automatic movement.
before: { buildPythonApplication, wrapGAppsHook, gobject-introspection, gtk3 }: buildPythonApplication { pname = "example"; version = "1"; nativeBuildInputs = [ wrapGAppsHook ]; buildInputs = [ gobject-introspection gtk3 ]; }
after: { buildPythonApplication, wrapGAppsHook, gobject-introspection, gtk3 }: buildPythonApplication { pname = "example"; version = "1"; nativeBuildInputs = [ wrapGAppsHook gobject-introspection ]; buildInputs = [ gtk3 ]; }

rationale: Adapted lexical-capture example with a literal namespace to make the collision visible. Intent is package-set foo; qualification is not a semantics-preserving style rewrite.
before: let foo = "local"; in with { foo = "package"; bar = "other"; }; [ foo bar ]
after: let foo = "local"; namespace = { foo = "package"; bar = "other"; }; in [ namespace.foo namespace.bar ]

rationale: Adapted config-dependent module conditional. mkIf delays the condition through module metadata; ordinary attrsets must not be rewritten.
before: { config, lib, ... }: { options.demo.enable = lib.mkEnableOption "demo"; options.demo.message = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.str; default = "off"; }; config = lib.optionalAttrs config.demo.enable { demo.message = "on"; }; }
after: { config, lib, ... }: { options.demo.enable = lib.mkEnableOption "demo"; options.demo.message = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.str; default = "off"; }; config = lib.mkIf config.demo.enable { demo.message = "on"; }; }

rationale: Adapted forum recommendation: ordinary right-biased // does not compose module metadata like mkMerge. Different conflict rules make this advisory.
before: { lib, ... }: { options.a = lib.mkEnableOption "a"; options.b = lib.mkEnableOption "b"; config = (lib.mkIf false { a = true; }) // { b = true; }; }
after: { lib, ... }: { options.a = lib.mkEnableOption "a"; options.b = lib.mkEnableOption "b"; config = lib.mkMerge [ (lib.mkIf false { a = true; }) { b = true; } ]; }

rationale: Adapted merged correction: outer single quotes cancel the shell quoting supplied by escapeShellArg. Fix requires shell lexical context.
Adapted separate defect from the same merged correction: escaping dirname's input does not quote its output; spaces still split.
Adapted merged restic environment correction. toString is not shell escaping. Literal data vs executable fragments must be distinguished.
Adapted documented argv contract: each ProgramArguments element is one argument. Do not split arbitrary strings or quoted argument values.
Adapted merged semantic-no-op removal of backslash-space. Ordinary string escape parity matters; valid escaped backslashes must remain.
Adapted optional readability preference, not deprecation: Nix PR 9645 explicitly removed the isNull deprecation warning. Higher-order uses remain valid.
Adapted solved shell-loop bug. Intended shell interpolation needs the indented-string escape; genuine Nix interpolation must remain untouched.
before: { script = ''for x in one two; do printf '%s\n' "${x}"; done''; }
after: { script = ''for x in one two; do printf '%s\n' "''${x}"; done''; }
